other_failure_modes.description: Encoding categorical features based on the overall frequency distribution of the entire dataset before cross-validation splitting leaks validation information into the training folds.

summary: The solution implements a reasonable K-fold cross-validation pipeline using CatBoost for regression. However, it applies median imputation and frequency encoding on the entire training dataset prior to generating CV splits, causing subtle data leakage between training and validation folds. Additionally, the ensembling consists merely of an unweighted average of the fold predictions.
